svg.title: Class C control zone — Billy Bishop chart-reading example
svg.desc: Original user-supplied chart excerpt, with its stacked label explained. Class C control zone: surface to 2,500 feet ASL. Class C terminal layer: above 2,500 to 12,500 feet ASL. Screenshot edition unknown.

g.text: Billy Bishop Toronto City Airport • chart-reading example
CONTROL ZONE = airspace type • C = airspace class
Follow the associated boundary and label together. Both layers here are Class C.
Source: user-supplied FltPlan screenshot. Labels redrawn for explanation; spacing simplified.
Chart edition unknown. Example limits and frequencies require current official confirmation.
Study illustration • not a navigation chart or flight authorization.
